claudecommand.tooltip: Command that is run inside the terminal, e.g. 'claude' or 'claude --continue'.

resumelast.description: Resume the last session of the project
resumelast.tooltip: Adds --continue to the Claude Code command when the project already has a session. Projects without one (e.g. new projects) start normally. Ignored if the command already contains --continue or --resume.

keepterminalopen.description: Keep terminal open after Claude Code exits

terminalcommand.tooltip: Optional template. {dir} is replaced by the project folder and {cmd} by the command to run, e.g.: kitty --directory {dir} bash -ic {cmd}

editorcommand.description: Text editor command (empty = preferred text editor)
editorcommand.tooltip: Used for editing CLAUDE.md and settings.json. The file path is appended. Empty uses the default application for plain text files.

showpaths.description: Show the folder path next to each entry

newprojectsdir.tooltip: 'New project...' at the bottom of the menu creates a sub-folder here.

projects-info.description: New projects found in ~/.claude/projects are added automatically when the menu is opened. Untick 'Show' to hide a project, and edit the name to rename it. Do not change the path of an entry.

extrafolders-info.description: Folders added here appear in the menu as well and start Claude Code directly in that folder. An empty name uses the folder name.
